caption: Comment DOCTOR for a free 15-min call about studying medicine abroad. No pitch, no pressure. Do you need Bulgarian to start medicine in Bulgaria? Pleven's English-language medicine programme teaches the medical course and entrance exam in English, while Bulgarian language classes are built into the course. Students learn enough for daily life and later patient communication, with translation tools there when needed.
